market_summary: US stocks fell for a second day on Thu Oct 29: Nasdaq -1.4%, S&P 500 -0.3%, with Alphabet -12.6% after its spend-and-miss quarter. Friday's session is a broad AI sell-off: at 2pm ET the Nasdaq-100 ETF was -3.95% and the S&P 500 ETF -2.0%, led by Intel (about -30%) after a weak Q4 guide; Amazon recovered most of a 7% early drop to trade about -2%. Treasuries rallied, with the 10-year near 4.91-4.94% from about 4.98%. Brent rose about 2% to roughly $113-117 after an attack on tankers in the Strait of Hormuz. The Bank of Japan held at 1.25% (8-1 vote) and signalled a December hike; the Nikkei fell 2.1%, and China's official October PMI is due Sat Oct 31 (consensus 50.0). Friday moves are intraday, not the close. Next: China PMI Sat; Apple Mon after close = Tue morning AEDT; RBA Tue 2:30pm AEDT.

AMZN.reason: Q3 EPS and revenue missed but AWS grew 39%, fastest in about five years. Shares fell 7% after hours and premarket; record -$42B trailing free cash flow worries the market.

AXOS.reason: FQ1 EPS up 16% YoY, NIM up 10bp QoQ, deposits up $848M. Adjusted EPS reportedly missed consensus; management guides faster loan growth in the Dec quarter.

BABA.reason: No company news found this window. China tech exposure; watch for AI capex sentiment spillover from the US selloff.

ENPH.reason: No new company news found since Oct 29. Rate-hike talk from Fed speakers is a headwind for residential solar financing.

FIGR.reason: No company news found this window. Crypto-linked names fell 6%+ premarket Friday after a reported $6.3B Binance hack and Bitcoin down 5%.

GOOGL.reason: Fell 12.6% Oct 29, worst day in 20+ years: EPS missed by 28%, search revenue light, free cash flow -$9.1B. Now 20%+ below its 52-week high.

LDI.reason: No company news found this window. Fed speakers flagging a possible December hike is negative for mortgage volumes.

META.reason: Down 20%+ from its 52-week high as the AI capex selloff spread Friday. No new company-specific news found this window.

MRVL.reason: Closed down 13% Oct 29 on reported all-stock talks to buy Lumentum (~$83B). No deal confirmed by either company. Dilution of 10%+ possible per Raymond James.

MU.reason: No company news found this window. Intel blamed weak PC demand on high memory prices, which supports pricing but signals demand risk.

NFLX.reason: No company news found this window. Less exposed to the AI capex selloff than other megacaps.

NVDA.reason: Fell with chips on fears hyperscalers overspend then cut in 2027; 12% below its 52-week high Friday. Amazon holding 2026 capex near $220B is supportive.

RKT.reason: Q3 beat: revenue $3.28B vs $2.59B est, adj EPS $0.15 vs $0.14. Rose 3% Oct 29 and 3% after hours. Q4 guide of $2.1-2.3B is below Q3.

TSM.reason: No company news found this window. Sold off with chips Friday on AI spending worries; Amazon capex plan intact.

STRIPE.reason: No new news found this window.

OPENAI.reason: Up to $30B round at $1.25T pre-money (cut from $1.4T) still open; commitments reportedly due Oct 30. No close announced, so no new mark.

headlines: Nasdaq down about 4% Friday midday on AI-spending fears, Intel's weak guide and oil above $100; VIX up 35%.
Amazon missed on EPS and revenue, but AWS grew 39%; 2027 capex to be meaningfully above $220B.
Alphabet closed Thursday down 12.6%, its worst day in over 20 years.
Marvell closed Thursday down 13% on a reported $83B all-stock bid for Lumentum; not confirmed.
Rocket revenue beat at $3.28B, but the Q4 guide is lower; Axos EPS up 16%.
Next: China PMI Saturday; Apple results Tue morning AEDT; RBA Tue 2:30pm AEDT.
